translation.search_intro_title: Search first, then hand it to the agent
translation.search_intro_body: Search is for fast, exact lookup across tracks, artists, albums, and playlists. The agent is for explanation, recommendation, and playback control.
translation.search_agent_hint: If you are not sure what to start with, send the result or the query straight to the agent.
translation.search_try_agent: When exact search comes up empty, the agent is usually better at finding adjacent styles and reframing the request.
translation.search_login_title: Search works even in guest mode
translation.search_login_body: Guest mode can search the public catalog. Sign in to AgentMusic only when you want to save playlists, favorites, and conversations.
translation.search_browse_hint: No query yet. Start by browsing something here.
translation.search_unavailable_hint: This track has no public preview. Connect Spotify for full playback, or upload a local file.
translation.search_send_track_to_agent: Ask Agent to explain and recommend
translation.search_send_album_to_agent: Ask Agent to break down this album
translation.search_placeholder: What do you want to play?
translation.library_empty_hint: Create one from the sidebar or keep exploring the catalog first.
translation.library_import_title: Import your music from other apps
translation.library_import_body: Bring your playlists, songs, and artists into one library.
translation.library_guest_body: Sign in to your AgentMusic account to create playlists, save tracks, and keep your own listening history.
translation.library_placeholder_body: This section will fill out as local favorites and more asset types land.
translation.library_audio_hint: Upload non-DRM .m4a or .mp3 files to keep them in your AgentMusic library and play them locally.
translation.library_spotify_connect_to_sync: Connect Spotify to sync saved tracks
translation.playlist_partial_playback_title: {{count}} tracks need Spotify or local audio
translation.playlist_partial_playback_body: Some tracks in this playlist do not have public previews. Connect Spotify to play the full track, or upload local m4a or mp3 files to your library.
translation.agent_subtitle: Ask your music agent to recommend tracks, explain songs, and drive the player.
translation.agent_preview_title: Give the agent its own workspace
translation.agent_preview_body: Guest mode can already search and chat. Signing in unlocks saved conversations and your own library.
translation.agent_login_body: You can already talk to the agent as a guest. Sign in only when you want saved chats and a personal library.
translation.agent_no_conversations: No saved conversations yet. Your first request will create one automatically.
translation.agent_empty_title: What do you want to hear today?
translation.agent_empty_hint: Ask for mood-based recommendations, details about the current track, or direct playback control.
translation.agent_message_placeholder: Try: recommend some music for late-night studying, or tell me about the current song.
translation.agent_input_hint: The agent returns both readable replies and structured actions. Playback instructions are executed automatically.
translation.agent_quick_prompt_1: Recommend something for late-night study sessions
translation.agent_quick_prompt_2: Play something in the style of Jay Chou
translation.agent_quick_prompt_3: Tell me about the current song
translation.agent_quick_prompt_4: Give me a lighter pop recommendation set
translation.agent_guest_body: Guest mode lets you chat and search right away, but conversations stay temporary until you sign in.
translation.agent_guest_saved_note: Guest conversations are temporary and are not saved after refresh.
translation.agent_saved_hint: This account can save conversations, playlists, and feedback in AgentMusic.
translation.agent_spotify_locked_body: Connect Spotify after signing in to unlock your Spotify top tracks, artists, and enhanced recommendation context.
translation.agent_spotify_unlocked_body: Spotify enhancement is active, so the agent can draw from your AgentMusic data plus Spotify taste signals.
translation.auth_register_body: This account powers your own playlists, favorites, listening history, and saved agent conversations.
translation.auth_login_body: Use your local AgentMusic account to unlock saved chats, playlists, and provider connections.
translation.auth_password_rule: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long.
translation.auth_login_hint: Use the same local account later to connect Spotify as an enhancement.
translation.spotify_requires_local_account: Sign in to AgentMusic first, then connect Spotify as an enhancement.
